paper.title_en: Subleading Asymptotic Charges in Massless Scalar QED
paper.abstract_en: We study subleading asymptotic charges of a U(1) gauge field coupled to a charged massless scalar field in Minkowski spacetime. We consider a phase space for which the scalar-field initial data on null infinity have compact support, while the gauge-field initial data admit an asymptotic expansion with inverse-power tails in retarded (advanced) time, which we refer to as initial-data tails. We identify three finite charges at the null infinities which are conserved under scattering. One is a renormalized version of the standard subleading soft charge. The second is a logarithmic charge which is the difference of the coefficients of the leading order tails at the future and past ends of null infinity. The third is a new charge that probes the average of the tail coefficients. We conjecture that the third charge is associated with a new class of large gauge transformations which diverge linearly in retarded time.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在闵可夫斯基时空中研究质量less标量QED的次领头渐近荷，识别出三个有限守恒荷并猜想与新的规范变换类相关，符合广义相对论基础方向，理论深度高且具有新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 无质量标量QED中的次领头渐近荷
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了闵可夫斯基时空中耦合至带质量less标量场的U(1)规范场的次领头渐近荷。我们考虑一个相空间，其中零无穷远处的标量场初始数据具有紧支撑，而规范场初始数据允许在推迟（超前）时间上具有反幂尾部的渐近展开，我们称之为初始数据尾部。我们在零无穷远处识别出三个在散射下守恒的有限荷。一个是标准次领头软荷的重整化版本。第二个是对数荷，它是零无穷远处未来端和过去端首阶尾部系数之差。第三个是一个新荷，它探测尾部系数的平均值。我们猜想第三个荷与一类在推迟时间上线性发散的新的大规范变换相关联。
